battleDescription: %user pivots swiftly and releases a sweeping arc of reinforced water chakra that tears into %target. As the surge crashes forward, a protective layer of water pressure envelops the user’s body, softening incoming attacks.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean; left unchanged. Description from round 1, in American spelling.

name: Tides of Despair
description: The user drowns every enemy in the area under a sorrowful tide of illusion. The ebbing waters wash back over the user, steadying their mind so the blows they take land softer as the tide recedes.
battleDescription: Waves of illusion crash down upon %target, carrying with them the weight of despair and failure. The enemy becomes overwhelmed by visions of loss and futility, their thoughts dulled by a mind too heavy to focus. The user's chakra synchronizes with the flow, reinforcing their mental defenses against incoming assaults.
fixes: battle: removed claimed enemy damage reduction (the effect is a self damage-taken reduction)
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the claim that the enemy's attacks are dulled, which no effect does. Description from round 1.

name: Tornado Fist
description: The user wraps a fist in a condensed cyclone and drives it into the target's core. The torn flesh keeps ripping, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
battleDescription: %user spins into action, wind chakra whipping around their arm in a vicious spiral. As they launch their fist forward, a condensed cyclone wraps tightly around the strike. The blow lands with explosive force against %target, tearing at their stance and disrupting their physical core. The turbulence doesn’t fade; it lingers. Wind chakra burrows beneath the skin and into the muscle, tearing at them from within. With the wound left open, %target keeps bleeding long after the blow has landed.
fixes: battle: replaced claimed taijutsu vulnerability with the wound damage over time it has
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the jutsu wounds rather than raising taijutsu damage taken, so the last two sentences now describe the lingering wound. An em dash is replaced. Description from round 1.

name: Torrential Fist
description: The user coils a raging torrent around their arm and unleashes it in a crushing punch. The surge floods back into their muscles, making their attacks hit harder until the tide ebbs.
battleDescription: A low hum fills the air as %user’s fist clenches, veins glowing faintly with surging water chakra. The liquid spirals violently around their arm, no longer gentle like a stream but raging like a storm barely contained. With eyes locked on %target, %user surges forward, each step leaving splashes in their wake. The punch lands with a brutal crash, detonating in a geyser of pressure that feels more like a tidal eruption than a strike. Steam rises from soaked ground as %user pulls back, aura pulsing, their strength now amplified by the very force that sought to drown their enemy.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes a stray leading percent sign and replaces an em dash. Description from round 1.

name: Toxic Pool
description: The user floods the ground with a bubbling pool of toxic chakra that scalds every enemy in the area. The poison seeps into their system, burning them each time they spend chakra or stamina over the next few rounds.
battleDescription: %user releases toxic chakra into the ground, forming a bubbling, acidic pool that spreads across the area. The vapor and liquid gnaw at whatever stands in it, inflicting immediate pain and poisoning the body. Every burst of chakra or stamina spent afterward worsens the poison.
fixes: battle: removed %target on a GROUND jutsu
battle: poison described correctly (triggers on chakra/stamina spent, not on staying in the area)
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes %target from a ground jutsu and corrects the poison, which bites when chakra or stamina is spent rather than for staying in the pool. Description from round 1.

name: Vacuum Palm
description: The user compresses wind into a thin, invisible edge around their palm and thrusts it straight through the target's guard. The vacuum lingers in the wound, leaving them open to heavier punishment from every attack for a short time.
battleDescription: %user focuses wind chakra into their palm, compressing it into a thin, invisible blade of force. With a single, precise thrust, they drive the strike through the air and into %target, piercing through defenses without warning. The impact disrupts muscular control and weakens the body’s ability to absorb further punishment. After being struck by Vacuum Palm, %target becomes noticeably more vulnerable to every attack, their guard compromised by the razor-thin force still lingering within.
fixes: battle: vulnerability applies to all damage, not only taijutsu
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the vulnerability covers all damage rather than only taijutsu, and two em dashes are replaced. Description from round 1.

name: Veil of Shadows
description: The user draws a veil of living shadow across the field, and its formless shapes lash at the target. The veil then settles over the user, turning part of the damage they take into health for a short time.
battleDescription: %user forms a slow, deliberate seal as an ominous haze spreads through the air, cloaking the battlefield in spectral mist. %target’s vision darkens as they’re pulled into an illusion where formless shadows lash out with invisible strikes. As the veil settles, a portion of every blow aimed at the user loops back to reinforce their health.
fixes: battle: absorb described as damage taken turned into health (not lifesteal from damage dealt)
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the absorb turns damage the user takes into health, not damage they deal. Description from round 1.

name: Volt Crash
description: The user hurls a crackling charge of lightning that crashes into the target with explosive force. The current clings to them, so every hit they take over the next few rounds burns a little deeper.
battleDescription: %user erupts in a flash of lightning, hurling the charge across the battlefield in an instant. With thunderclap velocity, it slams into %target like a living bolt, delivering a crushing impact that leaves sparks and destruction in its wake.
fixes: battle: removed movement claim (no move effect); the charge travels, not the user
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the user no longer crosses the field (no move effect), the lightning charge does. Description from round 1.

name: Volt Fang
description: The user sweeps a lightning-cloaked blade in a crackling arc that bites into the ground around the target. The surge flows back up the steel, making the user's attacks hit harder for a short while.
battleDescription: %user lunges forward and slashes %target with a blade cloaked in surging lightning chakra. The strike jolts through the enemy in a burst of current that races back up the blade, empowering every attack the user makes.
fixes: battle: removed claimed enemy debuff and Bukijutsu/strength-specific buff; buff applies to all damage
description: area wording no longer assumes enemies around the target
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes an enemy debuff it does not have and widens the user buff to all damage. Description from round 1 with the area phrase no longer assuming enemies are present.

name: Volt Jab Barrage
description: The user unleashes a flurry of lightning-charged jabs, each punch jolting the target's nerves. The shocks leave their body raw and exposed, so attacks against them hit harder for a short time.
battleDescription: %user’s fists spark to life as lightning surges through their limbs. In a flash, they close the distance and unleash a relentless barrage of precise jabs, each punch crackling with high-voltage chakra. Every hit sends jolts through %target’s nervous system, overloading muscles, rattling their nerves, and breaking their physical rhythm. As %target’s guard deteriorates, the electricity lingering in their body leaves them open, so every blow that follows lands harder.
fixes: battle: removed claimed speed/strength debuffs and user taijutsu buff; now the damage-taken increase it has
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the jutsu raises the target's damage taken, so the claimed stat debuffs and user taijutsu buff are replaced with that. An em dash is removed. Description from round 1.

name: Volt Reaper
description: The user whips a lightning-charged limb across the target in a reaping arc. The discharge coils around the user like a second skin, making all their attacks strike harder for a short while.
battleDescription: %user charges forward, lightning chakra crackling across their limbs in jagged, twitching arcs. With a sudden pivot, they slash their leg or arm across %target with blinding speed, the strike crackling on impact. As the chakra discharges, it doesn’t fade; instead, it coils around %user like a second skin.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; replaces an em dash and removes a trailing space. Description from round 1.

name: Wave Cleaver
description: The user swings their weapon in a wide arc and releases a cleaving wave of water that crashes over the target and the ground around them. Everything it batters stays soaked and reeling, taking extra damage from every hit for a short while.
battleDescription: %user swings their weapon in a wide arc, releasing a massive surge of compressed water chakra that rips toward %target. The cutting wave crashes forward like a tidal blade, delivering overwhelming force in a single sweeping motion.
fixes: description: area wording no longer assumes others stand around the target
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean; left unchanged. Description from round 1 with the area phrase no longer assuming others are present.

name: Weary Fists
description: The user drives a slow, crushing punch weighed down with dense chakra into the target. The chakra hardens around the user afterwards, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short time.
battleDescription: %user approaches with grounded steps, chakra coiling around their arm like lead. They drive a deliberate, crushing punch into %target, the force transferring with bone-deep weight. On impact, residual chakra lingers around %user, hardening into a dense field that turns a portion of incoming damage into health.
fixes: battle: absorb described as damage turned into health
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; says the absorb turns damage into health and removes a trailing space. Description from round 1.

name: Whirlwind Kick
description: The user spins into a gale-driven kick that tears through the target and the air close around them. Wind lingers in their joints and loosens their guard, so all attacks against them hit harder for a short while.
battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra through their legs and launches into a fierce spin, kicking with the force of a gale. Wind spirals outward in a sharp arc, amplifying the velocity and reach of the strike. When the blow lands, the shock tears through %target’s balance and muscular control. Wind chakra lingers in the joints, loosening their ability to brace or defend.
fixes: description: area wording no longer assumes enemies beside the target
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes a trailing space. Description from round 1 with the area phrase no longer assuming enemies are present.

name: Whispering Winds
description: A ghostly breeze whistles from the user's hand, slicing at the target and filling their ears with eerie whispers. The voices fray their nerve, leaving them more exposed to every kind of attack for a short time.
battleDescription: With a gentle sway of the hand, %user summons a spectral wind that whistles with haunted whispers. The gust slashes through %target’s senses, disrupting their mental clarity and unraveling their resistance to harm. The eerie presence lingers, amplifying every attack to come.
fixes: battle: vulnerability applies to all damage, not only genjutsu
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the vulnerability covers all damage rather than only genjutsu, and the caster is named with %user. Description from round 1.

name: Wind Scythe Barrage
description: The user flings a spiraling barrage of crescent wind scythes that cut through every enemy in their path. The rhythm of the assault sharpens the user's own edge, making their attacks hit harder for a short while.
battleDescription: %user whirls in a blur of motion, launching a barrage of crescent-shaped wind scythes across the battlefield. As the scythes fly, chakra surges through their body, sharpening their offensive edge and enhancing the power of future attacks.
fixes: battle: removed movement claims (no move effect)
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the movement it does not have. Description from round 1, in American spelling.

name: Abyssal Wraith
description: The user conjures wraiths from the abyss that swarm through the target's mind. Their haunting shapes rake at every sense the target has, landing a sharp blow of mental damage.
battleDescription: %user conjures the Abyssal Wraith, infusing %target's perception with illusions of malevolent wraiths. The haunting figures induce mental strain, escalating the torment experienced by %target. %user exploits the target's compromised mental state, launching calculated strikes that take advantage of their distracted defenses.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean; left unchanged. Description from round 1.

name: Bursting Compressed Air
description: The user packs air into a dense orb between their palms and bursts it at the target, punching straight through their defenses. The shock leaves them reeling, so attacks against them hit a little harder for a short time.
battleDescription: %user compresses air with precise chakra control into a tightly packed orb between their palms. With a sharp thrust, the orb explodes forward, releasing a concentrated shockwave that tears through the air. The blast distorts the surroundings as it barrels toward %target, hitting with the crushing force of pure atmospheric pressure.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; uses %target for the single target. Description from round 1, in American spelling.

name: Desert Illusions
description: The user traps the target in a mirage of shifting sand that crushes in around them. The phantom dunes may also mire their feet, leaving them unable to move for a short while.
battleDescription: With a subtle hand seal and a steady gaze, %user casts an illusion that traps %target in a mirage of shifting sands and scorching sun. In the false desert, every step becomes a struggle, and escape seems impossible. %target is struck by searing mirages while their movement is locked in the grip of the genjutsu’s disorienting landscape.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; swaps the generic 'the shinobi', 'the enemy' and 'The target' for %user and %target on a single-target jutsu. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Earth Release: Palm Push
description: The user thrusts a palm forward and a wall of solid force rises between them and the target. Blows land softer on the user, and the target's own attacks lose some of their bite for a short time.
battleDescription: With a grounded stance, %user channels earth chakra into their palm before thrusting forward. A sudden wave of solid force erupts, intercepting %target’s attack and dispersing its power. This technique reduces the damage %user receives while subtly shifting the incoming force, blunting the strength of %target’s attacks with controlled redirection.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the claim that it displaces the enemy (no movement effect) and names %target, whose attacks it weakens. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Earth Style: Shattering Kick
description: The user plants their weight and drives an earth-charged kick upward into the target. The ground cracks beneath their heel as the blow lands with crushing force.
battleDescription: %user drops low and plants their weight before delivering a crushing upward kick infused with earth chakra. The ground beneath their foot cracks as force surges through the strike, slamming into %target with seismic impact. The blow drives deep into their body, the earth chakra hammering home with the weight of the land itself.
rationale: Keeps the opening and the cracking-ground image; removes the charge forward and the knockback across the battlefield, which the jutsu does not do (damage only), and names %target. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Electric Maul
description: The user drives lightning chakra into the earth, and a tiger of crackling electricity bursts out to maul the target. Its claws leave their body jolted and exposed, so attacks against them hit harder for a short time.
battleDescription: %user slams their palm into the earth, channeling lightning chakra through the terrain. From the surge, a roaring tiger made entirely of crackling electricity erupts into view, its body outlined in streaks of blinding light. The beast charges %target with terrifying speed, pouncing and delivering a mauling strike of raw elemental force. This genin-level jutsu strikes fear into opponents through its fierce visual and devastating impact.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; swaps 'The user' and 'the enemy' for %user and %target. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Electric Surge
description: The user floods the target's mind with the illusion of a violent surge of lightning. The shock feels real enough that it stuns them, stealing time from their next moves.
battleDescription: As %user invokes the Electric Surge genjutsu, %target is enveloped in an illusionary surge of electricity. %target reacts instinctively, jerking as if shocked. The sensation is vivid, causing %target to momentarily lose focus, creating an opening for %user's next move.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Flash Kick
description: The user flashes across the field and lands in a storm of lightning-charged kicks. Every enemy around the landing spot is caught in the crackling flurry.
battleDescription: %user explodes forward in a storm of lightning-charged kicks, each strike cracking with blinding speed and power. The final roundhouse erupts in a flash of electricity, scattering a haze of sparks across the ground where %user lands.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the last clause used %target and a stagger-back on an empty-ground area jutsu, now it describes the burst around the landing spot. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Infernal Ascension
description: The user calls up an infernal blaze from within, their aura roaring into flame. Every fire technique they unleash burns far fiercer for a short time.
battleDescription: %user ignites their chakra into roaring flame, every motion blazing with destructive intensity. Their body radiates searing heat as they ascend into a state of relentless aggression, striking with explosive bursts of fire chakra. With each move, the user channels infernal energy that fuels their flame-based attacks, overwhelming the battlefield in blazing dominance.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Lightning Cloak
description: The user wraps their body in a crackling mantle of lightning. While it holds, their lightning techniques strike harder and ring with thunder for a short while.
battleDescription: %user surrounds their body in a radiant sheath of crackling lightning, each muscle fiber twitching with raw power. As they move, arcs of electricity trail behind them, lending raw force to every motion. Their strikes become charged with electric energy, enhancing the impact of all lightning-based techniques with devastating precision.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the claimed speed boost and the 'piercing' wording, since the jutsu only raises lightning damage. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Lightning Release: Holy Strike
description: The user clasps their hands in prayer and calls down a divine bolt of lightning on the target. The holy glare leaves them shaken, dulling the force of their attacks for a short while.
battleDescription: %user weaves a multitude of hand signs, then clasps their hands in a praying motion. Their body is cloaked in lightning that almost seems divine. In a swift motion, lightning arcs toward %target, delivering a devastating blow.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; fixes the garbled 'sends in their hands clasped' and 'giving a devastating blow', and removes a trailing space. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Molten Fury
description: A genjutsu that deals damage and inflicts lingering mental burns.
battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and initiates a searing genjutsu where molten lava pours from the sky, engulfing the target in a hellish illusion. Though the damage is purely mental, the torment lingers, causing %target to feel continuous internal burning that chips away at their psyche each turn. The illusion blurs reality, leaving them unsure if the pain will ever stop.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Phoenix Flame Illusion
description: Creates an illusion of a phoenix attacking with flames.
battleDescription: %user weaves a swift sequence of hand seals, unleashing an illusion of a colossal phoenix made of pure fire. The flaming bird ascends into the sky, then dives straight through %target in a blinding cascade of light. Though no physical flames touch them, the burning vision scorches their senses, delivering powerful mental damage.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Quicksand Mirages
description: The user bends the target's mind until the ground seems to swallow them, the illusion striking at their senses. Panic grips them as they sink, weakening their attacks for a short while.
battleDescription: %user bends the mind of %target and creates an illusion of them sinking into quicksand. The feeling is real as their body sinks into the sand, and they can feel it getting stuck under the pressure as they fall into a state of panic.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; fixes the run-on second sentence. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Rotting Bite
description: The user sinks phantom fangs into the target, and the illusion of rotting flesh spreads across their skin. The rot feeds the user, letting them heal from a share of the damage they deal for a short time.
battleDescription: %target feels a sharp sting as the illusion of rotting flesh spreads across their body. The horrific vision saps their will, activating lifesteal for %user as their strength feeds into the caster.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Shocking Discharge
description: The user looses a jagged bolt of lightning from their palm into the target. The shock seizes their muscles and stuns them, costing them precious time.
battleDescription: %user releases a sudden burst of concentrated lightning from their palm, sending a jagged bolt surging into %target. The impact is sharp and blinding, causing the target’s muscles to seize and their body to convulse. The shock leaves them momentarily immobilized, giving the user an opening to follow up or reposition.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Shockwave Fist
description: The user charges their fist with lightning and releases a crackling shockwave on impact. The surge rattles through the target and stuns them.
battleDescription: This technique charges %user’s fists with electrical chakra to deliver a crushing blow. Upon impact, the strike releases a violent surge of electricity that deals damage and stuns %target, leaving them momentarily unable to act.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Stone Circle
description: The user slams their hands to the earth and a ring of jagged stone pillars bursts up around the target. The pillars strike hard and may close in tight, leaving them unable to move for a short while.
battleDescription: %user slams their hands into the earth, channeling chakra that triggers a circular formation of jagged stone pillars to erupt around %target. The rising stones strike with force before closing in tightly, restricting movement and leaving the opponent vulnerable to follow-up attacks.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Stone Shuriken Technique
description: The user packs compacted earth into hard stone shuriken and hurls them at the target. Each one lands with the dull weight of rock, battering them with earth.
battleDescription: As %user creates shurikens from compacted earth, %target braces for the incoming assault. With a swift motion, %user hurls the stone shurikens at %target, each impact sending a shockwave of earth through %target's body. The barrage of shurikens leaves %target battered and bruised, struggling to withstand the relentless assault of earthy projectiles.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Stone Skipping
description: The user skims chakra-weighted stones low across the ground so they bounce into the target in quick succession. The battering leaves them off balance, so the blows that follow land harder for a short while.
battleDescription: %user channels chakra into a handful of flat stones, enhancing their mass and speed. With a precise flick of the wrist, the stones launch forward, skipping across the ground and striking %target with successive, chakra-infused impacts. Each bounce amplifies the force, turning a simple motion into a relentless barrage.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Tectonic Ascendancy
description: The user stamps down and draws the deep strength of the tectonic plates up through their body. For a short time, their earth techniques strike with far greater force.
battleDescription: %user slams their foot into the ground, awakening deep veins of earth chakra that ripple through their body. A surge of raw, grounded power builds beneath their feet, reinforcing their strikes with the weight of the land itself. This technique heightens the user’s affinity with earth, amplifying the force behind all subsequent earth-based attacks.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Tidefall Punch
description: The user coils water around their arm and drives it into the target like a falling tide. The spray settles over their own body, softening the blows they take for a short while.
battleDescription: %user surges forward, water spiraling tightly around their arm like a coiled serpent. As they drive their fist into %target, the crashing blow sends a shockwave rippling outward like a tidal surge erupting from their knuckles. The impact drenches the battlefield in pressurized chakra-infused water, fortifying %user’s body with a durable aquatic guard.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the em dash and swaps 'shield' for 'guard', since the effect is damage reduction, not a shield. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Tides of Sovereignty
description: The user commands the sea to rise within them, their chakra swelling like a spring tide. For a short time, every water technique they unleash hits with sovereign force.
battleDescription: %user draws deep from their water chakra reserves, their movements becoming smooth, forceful, and unrelenting like a rising tide. Each strike is infused with hydraulic pressure, reinforcing every blow with the crushing strength of flowing currents. The user’s water-based techniques become more destructive, mirroring the power of sovereign tides.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Water Shuriken
description: The user compresses water into razor-edged shuriken and sends them spinning at the target. Each one strikes with the force of a breaking wave.
battleDescription: %user channels chakra into their hand and swiftly generates a set of spinning water-formed shuriken. With a flick of the wrist, the projectiles are launched with deadly precision toward %target, slicing through the air and striking with sharp aquatic force. Each impact lands like a compressed wave, delivering solid damage.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Water Style: Water Beast
description: The user conjures a beast of churning water that surges forward and slams into the target. A vortex lingers around the user, turning part of the damage they take into health for a short while.
battleDescription: %user conjures a massive beast made entirely of churning water, which surges forward to slam into %target. As it crashes home, a swirling vortex lingers around %user, turning a portion of incoming damage into health. This technique balances offense with a defensive advantage.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; uses %user and %target and describes the absorb as turning damage into health. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Wind Release: Tempest Edge
description: The user wraps their weapon in a swirling vortex of wind chakra, honing its edge to a howling sharpness. They bring it down on the target with the force of a raging storm.
battleDescription: With a powerful swing, %user imbues their weapon with swirling wind chakra, forming a tempestuous blade. As they bring it down upon %target, the blade cuts through the air with a ferocious howl, striking with the force of a raging storm. The tempestuous energy enhances the blade's cutting power, aiming to inflict devastating damage upon impact.
rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Wind Vacuum
description: The user draws the surrounding air into a tight vacuum around their body, compressing their chakra. For a short time their attacks strike harder and the pressure blunts incoming blows.
battleDescription: %user draws in surrounding air with a deep inhalation, forming an intense vacuum around their body. As the pressure equalizes, their chakra surges violently, amplifying the force and sharpness of every technique they unleash. The surrounding atmosphere distorts slightly, blunting incoming blows and signaling the enhanced potential of their next strike.
fixes: boost is all damage, not wind only
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the damage boost applies to all damage, not only wind, and the damage-taken reduction is now hinted. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Zephyr Strike
description: The user lets a light breeze carry their weapon into a swift, cutting strike. The wind lingers around the target and turns against them, so their own attacks rebound on them for a short time.
battleDescription: As %user channels wind chakra into their weapon, a light breeze envelops the blade. %user strikes with swift grace, the edge flashing toward %target faster than the eye can follow. As it connects, the breeze clings to %target and twists against them. Each blow they throw is caught by the contrary wind and hurled back upon them.
rationale: Keeps the opening and the four-sentence shape; the user gets no speed buff, so the lines now show the strike on %target and the wind turning their own blows back on them (recoil). Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Phantom Requiem
description: The user calls up a ghostly mist that strikes the target and seeps into their body. Over the next few rounds it bleeds away their health, chakra and stamina.
battleDescription: %user forms a seal, summoning a ghostly mist that seeps into %target’s body. Wisps of blue and red energy, chakra and stamina along with their very life, are ripped from them, spiraling away into the mist. %target’s limbs grow heavy, their strength fading as exhaustion takes hold. If they don’t break free, they’ll collapse under the relentless drain.
fixes: removed implied gain for the user
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the em dashes, adds health to the drained pools and drops the claim that the energy flows to the user. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Seal of Nullification
description: The user binds the target in chains of sealing script that lock their chakra against any new enhancement. The same seals ward the user, shielding them from debuffs for a short time.
battleDescription: %user weaves intricate seals in the air, summoning glowing ethereal chains that surge toward %target, coiling tightly to disrupt their chakra flow, suppressing any attempts to invoke new enhancements while the last links settle over %user as a ward against debuffs.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; it does not strip existing buffs (it blocks new ones), and the user's debuff ward is now mentioned. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Primordial Blight
description: The user lays a festering blight on the target at close quarters, rotting at their body. The corruption can stop them from healing at all for several rounds.
battleDescription: %user summons a malevolent elemental blight of fire, water, wind, earth, and lightning that engulfs %target, scorching their vitality and corrupting their recovery, leaving them unable to mend against %user’s assault.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes 'freezing chakra flow' and 'weakened and defenseless', which the jutsu does not do, leaving damage and heal prevention. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder 2
description: The user calls down a storm that crashes over an area as a wave of lightning-charged water. The charge clings to every enemy it strikes, so their own attacks jolt back into them for a short while.
battleDescription: %user raises their hands, summoning a massive storm as dark clouds gather and electricity crackles through the air, unleashing a torrential wave of electrified water that crashes toward %target with violent force, striking with bolts of lightning and dealing devastating damage while leaving the battlefield drenched and charged with residual energy that clings to whoever it struck, turning their own attacks back upon them.
rationale: Keeps the original battle line; it has no heal prevention, so the lingering charge now describes the recoil on everything struck. Description from round 1, unchanged.

name: Storm Style: Divine Railgun 2
